text: {"lessons":["As a retired investor relying on these savings, I should prioritize preserving the account and avoiding large swings over chasing quick gains.","I should avoid frequent trades: acting on individual price moves can lock in losses, as my sales of Stocks A and C did, without ensuring the account is safer.","Before selling, I should consider each holding’s role and my overall plan rather than reacting only to its gain or loss versus my cost."]}
